text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor p-l-a-n-n-e-d a f-a-l-s-i-f-i-e-d p-r-o-g-e-n-y c-h-a-i-n t-o m-i-m-i-c b-r-e-e-d-i-n-g l-o-g-s and l-e-f-t a d-r-a-f-t t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e f-i-l-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the g-e-n-e-t-i-c v-e-r-i-f-y.
2) the actor f-o-r-g-e-d c-u-s-t-o-d-y c-e-r-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-e-s a-n-d i-n-v-o-i-c-e-s f-o-r u-n-t-r-a-c-e-d w-i-l-d c-a-p-t-u-r-e and l-e-f-t a s-h-a-d-o-w d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t s-e-t while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the p-e-r-m-i-t c-r-o-s-s-c-h-e-c-k.
3) the actor b-u-i-l-t s-t-a-g-e-d p-h-o-t-o s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e-s t-o i-m-p-l-a-n-t a g-r-o-w-t-h n-a-r-r-a-t-i-v-e and l-e-f-t a m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a s-t-r-i-p-p-e-d m-e-d-i-a p-a-c-k while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-m-a-g-e a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
4) the actor c-r-a-f-t-e-d a n-o-n-d-e-s-c-r-i-p-t-i-o-n l-i-s-t-i-n-g w-i-t-h a g-e-n-e-r-i-c c-a-r-e h-i-s-t-o-r-y and l-e-f-t a m-a-i-l-i-n-g b-l-o-b k-i-t while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the b-i-o-d-i-v-e-r-s-i-t-y c-o-n-c-l-u-d-e.
5) the actor p-r-e-p-a-r-e-d a s-c-r-i-p-t f-o-r h-a-n-d-l-i-n-g w-i-l-d-l-i-f-e o-f-f-i-c-e-r a-u-d-i-t-q u e-s-t-i-o-n-s and l-e-f-t a t-e-l-e-g-r-a-m m-c-r-o b-a-n-k while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the l-g-b-l c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e r-e-v-i-e-w.
